== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Pure Storm Baptism is a spiritual restoration [[technique]] originally developed by [[Tiberian Arelius|Tiberian]]. It serves as a method to reverse long-term damage sustained by the soul. While knowledge of this process is held by only a few remaining individuals, it requires significant resources to execute. The procedure functions as a cleansing mechanism that can remake the material of an individual's [[spirit]], though it is an intensive process that can leave the subject's channels strained and their [[spirit]] in a tender state. Successful application of the baptism can result in physical manifestations such as sparks of [[lightning madra]] moving across the body and [[spirit]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Eithan]] utilized his access to the Pure Storm Baptism [[technique]] to prepare specialized materials via the [[Soulforge]]. These resources were used to facilitate a process that allowed [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] to reach a new stage of the [[ritual]]. In exchange for undergoing this baptism, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] made an oath to [[Eithan]]. Ultimately, the procedure left [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s soul sufficiently stable to permit an [[advancement]] in its level of existence.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] has reached a new stage of the [[Pure Storm Baptism]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4">''Reaper'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] made an oath to [[Eithan]] in return for the [[Pure Storm Baptism]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Eithan]] has been using the [[Soulforge]] to prepare materials for the [[Pure Storm Baptism]] that [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] enjoyed.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Pure Storm Baptism]] is a resource/[[technique]] [[Eithan]] has access to.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18">''Reaper'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s soul was stable enough after the [[Pure Storm Baptism]] to advance its level of existence.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18" />}}</li>
